## Prior-known literal counterexample/source correction

Problem 30004409 / OWR-17471-016, rank 1073. Authored target status: already_solved, 0/5. This proof-and-audit-only draft records a credited application of a prior-known Hopf-link computation. No new discovery or new mathematical proof-search turn is claimed. The repository QUEUE remains untouched.

The literal source uses the full smooth unordered/unoriented R3 quotient and includes the single-edge tree. The explicitly imported Boyd–Bregman smooth theorem gives Q8, while that tree's RAAG is Z^2. The authored proofs show Q8 cannot embed in GL2(R), hence cannot be any actual subgroup of Aut(Z^2). The Dahm image is V4 and its central kernel is C2. Revised conjectures and a general connected-forest computation remain unresolved here. The separate S3 source warning is not a premise.

Mandatory wording clarification: the oriented-and-labelled component has fundamental group C2, the kernel associated with the connected fourfold cover. This is not a claim that this cover has degree two. The original proof is preserved with this additive clarification accepted in README.md and ACCEPTANCE.md; no mathematical correction to the proposition or exact sequence is required.

Read [the current acceptance](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/research/hopf-tree-30004409-proof-audit-only/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004409/ACCEPTANCE.md), [the proof application](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/research/hopf-tree-30004409-proof-audit-only/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004409/original/PROOF_APPLICATION.md), and [the independent mathematical acceptance](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/research/hopf-tree-30004409-proof-audit-only/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30004409/audit/INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE.md).

## Verification and scope

- Original proof manifest: a9574bdd908b71ac3bb3fda27e68d3818679706e12847e5482b24b6e8540ae3a. Historical audit manifest: 842c7433b24296f2202fb83069ec94ece951db9e44e383339a74995e6c426b7c. Original authored files remain byte-exact.
- 36 fresh finite-checker runs in normal/-O/-OO: six positive runs and 30 named mathematical mutations rejected. Full unmodified stdout/stderr are preserved using a launcher that compiles authenticated source under its public relative filename. Every fresh replay must match the same-mode, same-label reference byte-for-byte, including recursive exact JSON types and values.
- 156 hostile/direct-comparison rejections and 9 unchanged-output comparisons across all modes, including 48 direct output comparison rejections. Test-only manifest repinning is labeled and cannot confer publication trust. No unauthenticated malicious verifier executed.
- The final fixed external bootstrap authenticates the complete current authored delivery, including acceptance, code, historical manifests and all delivered receipts. Final runs passed as UID/EUID 1000 with actual directory-create and existing-file write-open denials and unchanged bytes. Earlier control/outer stages are explicitly labeled; no circular self-containing hash is asserted.
- The historical independent validation receipt is omitted because its traceback locations expose workspace paths. Its original digest/size remain provenance. The retained historical audit manifest describes historical evidence and is not the current delivery inventory. Fresh complete public-path receipts replace its delivery role.
- Public scholarly URLs, titles, PDF hashes/sizes, manuscript status and historical retrieval/inspection limits are retained. Publication preparation did not perform fresh PDF retrieval, PDF rehash, or corpus rehash. Goldsmith full-text inspection was not achieved. The smooth topological theorem is explicitly imported, not machine-proved by the finite checks. No bounded matrix enumeration substitutes for the proof over all GL2(R).

## External trust anchor

Copy bootstrap.py outside the delivery and verify this independently recorded SHA-256 before execution. Run Python 3 with -I -S -B, also -O and -OO, as UID 1000 with read-only inputs. The sole positional input is the authored delivery root. Symlinks, unlisted files/directories, writable inputs, altered receipts and integrity-bypass options are rejected. This packet requires no source PDF, dataset, or repository tracker to reproduce its finite checks.
